content: Nandini emailed Vikram about not receiving the renewal documents for her life insurance policy LP-001234 and expressed concern about the approaching deadline. Vikram apologized, resent the documents with an attachment, and reminded her that the policy must be finalized by the 20th to avoid a lapse in coverage.

Nandini to review the attached renewal documents and confirm completion before the deadline
